'''Sangi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] and [[Technician/Legends|technician]] in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] who was knocked unconscious by [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] during the [[Second Battle of Roche]], after she pulled out her [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]].
